expected_invariant: Counted RK4 evaluations equal 4 N per trajectory; endpoints match the great circle; a capture must name this workload and this host's CPU model and RAPL zones.
experiment: Integrate each geodesic with RK4 (N = 256) and adaptive DP5(4); count evaluations; when CIW_LAB_RAPL_LOG names a capture from `python -m ciw.lab.energy_gpu_telemetry rapl-capture` (repeated fixed-step batches, three by default, then an idle interval of equal length), gate and analyze it.
failure_modes_checked: capture absent, malformed, for another workload or another host (regression tests)
RAPL counter wrap (one wrap allowed; regression test)

findings.claim: Gross CPU package energy (background-inclusive, idle not subtracted) per geodesic trajectory

notes: no RAPL capture was supplied; the lab runner reads no energy counter (capture with `python -m ciw.lab.energy_gpu_telemetry rapl-capture` and set CIW_LAB_RAPL_LOG)

findings.claim: Idle-subtracted CPU package energy per geodesic trajectory (equal-length idle bracket after the workload)

hypothesis: The deterministic work of a fixed-step RK4 geodesic trajectory is exactly 4N right-hand-side evaluations; its CPU energy can be read only from package counters bracketing a batch, which an operator captures outside the lab runner.
input_data: 6 unit-speed geodesics on the unit sphere from the equator, headings [0.7, 0.85, 1.0, 1.15, 1.3, 1.45] rad, length 3.0
optional operator capture named by CIW_LAB_RAPL_LOG
mathematical_model: E_gross = sum over package domains of (E(after) - E(before)) / (repeats * trajectories), one wrap allowed; E_idle-subtracted = (E_gross_total - E_idle * t_work / t_idle) / (repeats * trajectories); work proxy W = 4N evaluations (RK4) or the Dormand-Prince count.
numerical_result: 1024 evaluations per RK4 trajectory; max endpoint error 1.09e-09; adaptive evaluations [487, 427, 361, 337, 313, 295]; energy: not measured (no accepted RAPL capture; the runner reads no counters)
observation_model: Evaluations counted by wrapping Surface.geodesic_rhs; a supplied capture is read-only input whose raw bytes are retained; wall/CPU time retained only as an artifact.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

recommended_next_task: Capture T115 on a Linux host with readable intel-rapl counters, then T120 to relate precision to measured energy
